how_to_submit: A pack is one .bbpack file: a zip of manifest.json and content.json, or the same JSON saved with a .bbpack name. Include a name, an author, a version, and content. Do not put executables in the zip. To offer a pack, open a pull request that adds the file and a row in index.json (id, title, author, summary, file). The public pack list is Johno222222222/ue5-systems-training-tool-packs. Anyone can still import a file from disk.
